-Updated the zone reveal cutscenes to include the new gathering nodes.
-Limited Merchant Inventory to have a maximum number of items they can carry.
[i]Developer Note:[/i] We understand inventory limitations are never fun, but this shouldn’t be so limited that it is problematic. We encourage players to make use of selling, salvaging, their Cache, and mass sales to Traveling Merchants to keep their Merchant inventories under control.
-The Mystic has been moved to a location closer to the player shop.
-Does anyone know who lives in that new tent in Terafell?
-Added the following graphics settings:
--Quality (Ultra, High, Medium, Low, Very Low)
--Screen Mode (Fullscreen, Borderless, Windowed)
--VSync 
--Anti-aliasing
--Resolution
-Favor rewards now offer Research Scrolls at more appropriate values.
-Adjusted dungeon loot tables to include materials more appropriately.
-Removed Profession Trades from the game. 
[i]Developer Note:[/i] We are not happy with how Profession Trades were tying in with many of the newer features and are taking the feature back to the drawing board to find a way to make it fit better within the game. This could be as improved Profession Trades or tied into a different feature.
Added a ‘Center’ button on the Region Map.

[b]Bugs[/b]
-Fixed an issue when opening low level loot boxes with only high level heroes would sometimes cause an error.
-Fixed an issue when certain notifications could cause the game not to close the UI overlay.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 25th
notes.content:
This patch revamps the Researching process and display, as well as resolves a common cause of game crashes. 

User Interface
-Fixed some text displays on the Custom Dungeon Panel.
-Closing the Custom Dungeon Panel will now disable the green highlight in the Commands Panel, as intended.
-Did an Overhaul of the Research Panel.
-Repositioned the ‘Reel’ button while fishing.
-Added an indicator under ‘Reel’ which lets the player know they can use Space to reel instead of having to click ‘Reel’.
-The ’Reel’ button now shows up on top of panels so it can be clicked in any state.
-Added a quick message popup when something is not able to be done. For example, trying to start Research for a different profession while a Research is already going.

Functionality
-Fixed an issue where the game would suffer frame loss upon hero deaths.
-Did an overhaul of the Research system in preparation for the Crafting rework.
	-Increased Research Time & Cost.
	-Research progress is now persistent through Save/Load.
	-Introduced Research Scrolls as an item that Hemdall may now sell on occasion. We will be adding more interesting ways to acquire Research Scrolls in the future, along with the Crafting update, to help with the increased Research cost.
	-Researching within a Tier will now only apply to that Tier.
-Crafting is now only unlocked up to Tier II. This will be increased with the Crafting update in a future patch, along with gathering nodes which contain Tier III and Tier IV materials.
-Added a maximum item craft quality of 10, but also increased the power gains from each level of Quality.
-Added some optimizations to the Camera system, which should slightly increase performance.
-Players may now properly use multiple of the same bait in different bait slots while fishing.

Bugs
-Fixed some instances of game crashes.
-Fixed an issue with multiple uses of the same bait resulting in improper displays.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 22nd
notes.content:
This patch introduces the first stage of the much requested Custom Dungeon Groups. It also addresses some performance issues and visual improvements.

User Interface
-Adjusted scaling of various User Interface elements.
-Changed multiple display icons.
-Added a highlight to the selected realm on the Main Menu.
-Changed the enemy border color for bosses.

Functionality
-Added Custom Groups to the game. Custom Groups can be started by selecting the new ‘Custom Dungeon’ option in the Officer Command Panel after completing Redclaw’s Lair.
-Added performance optimizations, which should result in less crashes.
-Locating and Canceling a task can now be done with left and right click on the task icon respectively, where appropriate.
-Adjusted frequency of World Heroes visiting your shop.
-Adjusted the likelihood of World Heroes making purchases from your shop.

Bugs
-Fixed an issue with Ferocity items not rolling properly on Dungeon gear. This modified all item stat rolls on Dungeon gear as a result.
-Fixed some instances of Officers not going to the Dungeon they were sent to.
-Fixed some instances of World Heroes and Officers idling in front of your shop.
-Fixed some instances of Officers not being able to be created.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 19th
notes.content:
This patch is mainly meant to resolve several instances of game functions not working as intended.

Bugs
-Fixed instances of items not transferring out of the Cache with proper amounts.
-Fixed a bug that caused guild dungeon clears to not register.
-Fixed a bug that caused craft orders to not restart after loading.
-Fixed a bug that caused the Player’s Inventory to not register clicks when loaded.
-Fixed a bug that caused the Trade Offer buttons to not register clicks.
-Fixed a bug that caused the “Squish a Fish” Chapter step to not complete.

Functionality
-Added the ability to craft utilizing the items that are in your Cache as well as the Player’s inventory.
-Added the ability to feed your officers fish from your Cache as well as the Player’s inventory.
-Added a Destroy Button to the hero panel. Abolish a hero from your realm at the click of a button.. muahaha!

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 18th
notes.content:
This patch includes fundamental reworks of several mechanics in the game which should lead to performance increases, as well as some new features. It should be live on Steam soon!

User Interface
-Updated Officer Command Panel appearance.
-Updated the visual indicator when an item is an upgrade for an officer to show a more apparent upgrade arrow as opposed to the previous ‘+’ indicator.
-Updated the Biting Beetle icon to no longer be the same as Soft Fur.
-Updated the Monster Part icon to no longer be the same as Creature Brain.
-The Fish-O-Matic 3000 has had some small improvements to more clearly represent your squishing progress.
-Added a “Hide UI” button to toggle showing or hiding the User Interface. By default, this button is ‘-’. Note that this is only for the permanent UI such as Merchant Portrait and Kingdom score, not for the Panels.
-Fixed some verbiage mismatches where it would sometimes read “Gear Score” when it should read “Combat Score”.
-Other various UI changes.

Functionality
-The Quest Cache has been reworked to now just be your ‘Cache’ but contains several different tabs.
	Quest Cache Tab - Where all items turned into you from Quests will go. (Unchanged)
	Material Cache, Weapon Cache, Armor Cache and Consumables Cache have all been added as separate tabs as well.
	To use the Cache, use the newly added ‘Stash Items’ checkbox, and this will allow you to stash items on a per item basis. Uncheck the ‘Stash Items’ to stop transferring.
-Shopkeeping has been added to the command panel.
	You are able to assign one or multiple officers to take over the shop as ‘Shopkeeper’. They are not as skilled as you are at shopkeeping, so they will accept all buy/sell options, and also accept all quest pick-ups and turn-ins.
	Officers receive small XP gains for each transaction they complete, and there is a small Energy cost associated with each transaction as well.
-The Crystalline Converter has appeared on the Terafell dock. This mysterious machine allows for the salvaging of gear into Nacreous Crystals, which are in turn able to be used to craft into Materials.
-Added two additional save profiles. (Note that while we have done rather extensive testing on these save profiles and they seem to be stable, before starting a new profile it is advised to backup the local files of your main save first.)
-Optimized battle groups and enemy actions to smooth performance while there are multiple instances of combat happening. This should result in better performance overall in games, particularly late games with many instances of combat.
-Hero task functionality has changed to not require as much searching from the AI, this will result in a small boost in game performance.
-The Fish-O-Matic 3000 now allows you to squish fish and store progress made for further oil crafting. This means even if a fish only gets you .2 value toward Fish Oil, you are still able to squish it and store that .2 until you have more fish to finish the craft.
-DPS Meters have been added to the game, along with a new tab on the Dungeon panel called ‘Hero Performance History’.
-Increased drop rates of cloth materials from dungeons.
-When a hero is idling in town, they will now slowly roam the town to better indicate this.
-Transfering items from Cache into Merchant Inventory now happens in stacks as opposed to individually. This functionality was implemented as individual transfers for performance reasons, but with this update we are now able to bypass that.
-Added a check for dungeon groups to reform if any factors impacted or broke apart the group.

Bugs
-Fixed an issue where Ferocity was not able to roll on some crafted items.
-Fixed some instances of items duplicating instead of transferring when transferring out from the Quest Cache.
-Fixed an issue with the crafting quantity slider sometimes not functioning as expected.
-Fixed several instances of potential memory leaks. Please continue to report any instances of game crashes.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 13th
notes.content:

-Added a pop-up panel to the experience and energy bars on the Hero Panel.
-Added a tooltip to the Goods Vendor panels to help with the process of ordering goods.
-Added a note to the Fish-O-Matic 3000 to assist in how to properly squish a fish.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 12th
notes.content:
The main purpose of this patch is to update some of the UI to increase font sizes and sizes of the panels. There is also some moving of the main UI to accommodate this. This patch also fixes instances of customers leaving the shop and remaining in the queue and instances of items not having the correct actions available to them.

Functionality

-Adds a cap of 100 World Heroes and 15 Customers until the deeper optimization pass can occur.

Bugs

-Fixed instances of customers showing up in the queue when in other parts of the realm.

User Interface

-Changed multiple icons for gold and weight.
-Changes icons for Combat/Gold display on Item Cells.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 4th
notes.content:
This patch fixes instances of heroes being stuck in dungeons looting. It also introduces a new back-end item handling system in order to slightly improve performance. Furthermore, it introduces the ability to start a larger Craft Order.

Functionality
-Adds the ability to choose the exact amount of crafts you would like to start with a slider. This will act as one order and you will receive the full amount of the order after the Craft Order is completed.

Bugs
-Fixed a bug that would erase hero buffs after saving/reloading.
-Fixed a bug that erased hero experience/gold reward for written quests after saving/reloading.
-Fixed instances of heroes being stuck in a dungeon and shown as “Looting”.
-Fixed a bug that prevented players from adding Star Coins.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 28th
notes.content:
This patch fixes many instances of hero AI not acting correctly, as well as adds some extra balancing changes, including how Favors choose items. Please read below for full details.

[b]Functionality[/b]
-Made balancing modifications to several end game dungeons to better align with previous item balancing adjustments.
-Changed the Favor item requests to not include base materials such as Fir Logs or Tin Ore, but instead uses their upgraded versions. Note that this does not affect fish.

[b]Bugs[/b]
-Fixed multiple instances of officers not following your commands when sending them to Dungeons.
-Fixed multiple instances of heroes and officers being stuck in an endless looting or battling enemies state while in Dungeons or just after completing them.
-Fixed multiple instances of heroes creating new dungeon groups when already existing groups had spots open. This was being caused by heroes being rejected from joining the existing group due to a role mismatch, or being too undesirable.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 27th
notes.content:
This patch provides a nerf to the first 10-Man Raid (Rite of Mourning) and introduces a continuation feature for Trade Offers. It also adds the ability for world heroes to create their own guild.

Functionality
-Introduces ability to continue Trade Offers after completing the current available, with an increase to the required quantity and a better reward.
-Introduces the chance for a world hero to create their own guild. The player will still be able to send an invite to these heroes with a reduced chance of being accepted.
-Reduces the overall power of the enemies of Rite of Mourning.

User Interface
-Updated order of the Escape Menu.

notes.content:

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 26th
notes.content:
This patch fixes many hero behaviors which caused them to no longer perform as expected in several situations. It also largely changes the way stats roll on items and slightly weakens enemies to compensate. This makes the game more difficult overall. Also made more improvements for the user interface.

User Interface
-Fixed fishing Lures to now show information when ‘i’ is clicked.
-Changed the death skull to no longer appear over the entire Officer Panel.
-Updated world combat display to show hero and enemy icons.
-Slight adjustment on hero display with Goods Vendor orders.
-Removed a particle glow effect when adding Star Power to Guild Heroes. This will return in a much better way in the future.

Functionality
-Rebalanced all items to have lower possible rolls for stats. (This will affect items in current games as well, be sure to check your hero power before sending them to content they used to be able to clear!)
-Lowered enemy stats slightly to compensate. (Note that overall, the game is more difficult despite these nerfs.)
-Reduced the likelihood of world heroes joining Dungeons before having sufficient gear.
-You are no longer able to send Guild Members on Deliveries or Trade Routes with other cities. This was always the intended behavior.
-Changed how Deliveries generate to prevent absurdly high Deliveries from occurring.
-Removed the behavior of NPC’s sometimes disappearing. This was intended behavior as it was them returning to their homes, however, we will reintroduce this when it is able to be more clear that is what’s happening.

Bugs
-Fixed a bug with Neri Goods Vendor that was not registering clicks.
-Fixed more instances of Heroes getting stuck in world combat.
-Fixed an issue causing orders through Goods Vendors to fail.
-Fixed instances of heroes gathering in front of your shop and getting stuck.
-Fixed instances of heroes no longer purchasing gear from your shop.
-Fixed instances of gathering nodes no longer replenishing.
-Fixed instances of Heroes making their own dungeon group instead of joining one which already existed.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 24th
notes.content:
This patch fixes several minor bugs associated with the UI/Weekly Vault/Scrolls/Deliveries. This also fixes a game breaking bug associated with the new customer limit. Read below for detailed patch notes.

User Interface

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 23rd
notes.content:
This patch fixes many more UI inconsistencies and display issues to help with visibility across various system types and resolutions. It also addresses several instances of balancing. Please note that we are working on a full rewrite of the in-game tutorial to deliver information more seamlessly, and in a more appropriate order to coincide with how the game progresses. This is expected to be introduced into the game in the coming few days. Read below for detailed patch notes.

User Interface
-Text size on various UI elements has been increased.
-Included several UI indicators to better explain what the purpose of the UI is.
-Added more noticeable color indicators for different rarities of gear and materials.
-Reworked the Officer Panel Display in preparation for the larger UI rework on the way.
-Changed many circles in the UI to Squares in preparation for the larger UI rework on the way.
-Changed wording on several UI elements to be more clear.
-Changed the background of the panel's locations when dragging to reorganize them.
-Increased the size of the item interaction buttons that show on hover.
-Slightly increased the spacing between items for all panels where items may be stored.
-Removed a Merchant Panel that is going to be reintroduced for a future feature.

Functionality
-The camera will now stay where it was before you pressed ‘Esc’ when you return to the game.
-You may now press ‘Esc’ again to exit the ‘Esc’ menu/unpause the game.
-You may now take down quests while heroes are on them, this will automatically remove all heroes from the Quest.
-Introduced the ability to begin serving more than 4 customers based on your reputation level. You may now serve one extra customer for every 5 levels you gain on your Merchant.
-Your Storefront now starts with a possible weight of 100, but increases by 50 every 5 levels, instead of remaining at 200 for the entire game.
-The Volunteer command is now properly functioning.
-Volunteering and Exploring will now just perform one single instance of each, instead of chaining them endlessly.
-Volunteering and Exploring are no longer Quest types and can now only be performed by officers directly through the command panel.
-Using the ‘Main Menu’ button will now save your game before taking you to the Main Menu.
-The ‘Locate’ button on the Hero Panel will now also count toward tutorial progress.
-Starter gear for all heroes may now be destroyed.

Gameplay
-All dungeons have had their difficulty slightly lowered. The Rite of Mourning Raid, however, was further lowered in difficulty. (Note that Rite of Mourning is still difficult!)
-Updated recommended Combat Scores to more properly reflect their difficulty.

Bugs
-Fixed a customer interaction bug preventing them from reacting accordingly when the interaction was completed.
-Fixed a bug causing the tutorial to go from Chapter 1 to Chapter 2 without claiming your reward.
-Removed a broken model that caused spikes to protrude from a Human Male hero.
